name: guilherme-dev-workflow
description: Global strategic, engineering, UI/UX and security workflow plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: parceiro-estrategico-global
plugins.description: Global strategic layer: discovery, verification, critical reasoning and dynamic capability routing across available skills/plugins/tools; proposes new capabilities when a real gap exists.

plugins.name: dev-workflow-standard
plugins.description: Engineering Harness: scale intent contracts to complexity, invoke specialist/executor capabilities, capture execution evidence, validate results, recover or replan, and review delivery.

plugins.name: ui-ux-standard
plugins.description: Mockup-first UI/UX, design systems, media prompts, accessibility, and visual QA.

plugins.name: security-standard
plugins.description: Risk-based AppSec review, threat modeling, validation, remediation, and security release gates.

plugins.name: sdd-spec-factory
plugins.description: Spec-driven factory: turns requests into product/module/page/component/validation/database/API/UI specs and an executable task with PR and QA/review checklists.

plugins.name: dev-environment-standard
plugins.description: Portable environment bootstrap, MCP discovery and evidence-based plugin health.

plugins.name: dev-implementation-standard
plugins.description: Executor/coder: implements an approved task strictly within its spec scope on the suggested branch, runs required commands, updates the task result, and prepares the PR.
